summary.summary:
Migrated basin3d/core/schema/query.py to pydantic 2 API:
- Replaced __get_validators__/__modify_schema__ custom types with __get_pydantic_core_schema__ / __get_pydantic_json_schema__ (MonitoringFeatureIdentifier, WGS84BoundingBox). Plain-validator raises ValueError for non-4-sequence input so bad bbox inputs become ValidationErrors; numeric check preserved (strings rejected).
- Removed the BoundingBox BaseModel wrapper; unions now use WGS84BoundingBox directly (value kept as tuple, as before).
- class Config -> model_config = ConfigDict(...); allow_population_by_field_name -> populate_by_name; validate_all dropped (no ConfigDict equivalent; defaults are already valid).
- min_items -> min_length.
- Optional fields without a default now get default=None (V2 makes Optional fields required otherwise).
- SynthesisResponse.query typed SerializeAsAny[QueryBase] so subclass fields are still serialized.
- translate.py: query.copy() -> query.model_copy().
Updated pyproject.toml dependency pin from pydantic<2 to pydantic>=2.0,<3. No companion packages (web frameworks/plugins) are pinned in the repo.
Test suite: 484 passed, 2 skipped (pre-existing --runintegration gated integration tests).
